name: redmine
description: 讓 Claude 代你操作 Redmine：查詢、建立、修改、記工時、附件與刪除（刪除與重大異動會先請你確認）
long_description:
以你自己的 Redmine API 金鑰連線，Claude 只能看到、改到你在 Redmine 上本來就有權限的內容。刪除與重大異動會先請你確認。

**取得 API 金鑰：** 登入你的 Redmine，打開「我的帳號」→ 右側「API 存取金鑰」→「顯示」（也可以直接打開 `你的 Redmine 網址/my/api_key`），按「Configure」貼上即可。

---

Connects with your own Redmine API key, so Claude can only see and change what you already have access to in Redmine. Deletions and other high-impact changes ask for your confirmation first.

**Get your API key:** sign in to your Redmine, open "My account" → "API access key" → "Show" (or open `<your Redmine URL>/my/api_key`), then click "Configure" and paste it.

allowed_directories.title: 允許存取附件的資料夾（選填）/ Folders for attachments (optional)
allowed_directories.description: Claude 只能從這些資料夾上傳檔案、或把附件下載到這些資料夾；不設定就不能上傳/下載附件。Claude can only upload from, or save attachments to, these folders. Leave empty to disable attachments.
